name: Issue 3366: Warding Rune dispels magic and voids harmful magic duration on the caster for 6s
contract: 804232 eff1 is native SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL (Spell::EffectDispel, SpellEffects.cpp:2911) targeting
DISPEL_MAGIC (misc=1) on the caster. eff0 applies stock WotLK aura 245
(SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL), bp=-101, misc=1, for 6000ms (SpellDuration id 32, matching the
AddPct(duration, -101) on any harmful aura whose Dispel type matches, driving its duration to (near)
Fixture spell 6136 'Chilled' (Dispel=1 Magic, a harmful SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED debuff, native
duration 5000ms) exercises both effects: it is dispelled by eff1 when already present, and gets ~0
from eff0 when applied while Warding Rune is active. No CoA code runs at 804232.
